description: This file defines classes and types related to a computation graph in the torch::nativert namespace, including Value, Node, Graph, and Type, along with associated methods and utilities for graph manipulation and serialization.

classes.name: Type
classes.description: Represents data types in the graph, including simple and custom object types.

classes.name: Value
classes.description: Represents a symbolic value (tensor, list, etc.) used as input/output of nodes.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Represents a computational operation or unit within the graph.

classes.name: Graph
classes.description: Represents the entire computation graph, managing nodes, values, and graph transformations.

methods.name: addInput
methods.description: Adds an input value to the graph.

methods.name: addOutput
methods.description: Adds an output value to the graph.

methods.name: createNode
methods.description: Creates a new node without inserting it into the graph.

methods.name: insertNode
methods.description: Inserts a new node into the graph at the current insertion point.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves a value by name, throws if not found.

methods.name: tryGetValue
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a value by name, returns nullptr if not found.

methods.name: replaceAllUses
methods.description: Replaces all uses of a value with another.

methods.name: renumberValues
methods.description: Reassigns IDs to all values to be contiguous.
